company_profile.description: ZIEHL-ABEGG is a global manufacturer specializing in fans, drive systems, and control technology. Founded in 1910 by Emil Ziehl in Berlin, the company is headquartered in Künzelsau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It operates 16 production plants and 29 sales offices worldwide. The company offers products in three main categories: ventilation systems (including axial and centrifugal fans), drive systems, and control technology such as frequency inverters. ZIEHL-ABEGG is known for innovations like the external rotor motor developed in the 1950s.
